Tailored Client Acquisition Infrastructure

Appointment Optimization

The CloseMore Advantage

Built Exclusively for Growth-Minded Insurance Agents

Standard agencies focus on "clicks" and "impressions". We know those metrics don't deposit into your bank account. Our systems align directly with your cost per written policy.

Higher Quality Exclusive Leads

We target buyers searching explicitly for answers, not cheap prize-wheel sweepstakes entrants. Your leads are 100% exclusive to you.

Conversion-Focused Campaigns

We write copy designed to filter out visual non-buyers, qualifying clients based on state licensure, health conditions, and budget constraints.

Niche Insurance Expertise

We understand compliance guidelines, state licensing rules, and the language that moves buyers in life, Medicare, and commercial insurance.

Transparent Real-Time Reporting

Log in to your portal anytime. Track leads, bookings, ad spend, and cost per booked call without having to ask for manual spreadsheets.
